enGB:
A champion spirit is a paragon of skill at arms.
Spirit Bonus: When you channel a champion, your spirit bonus applies on attack rolls, CMB, non-spell damage rolls, Strength checks, Strength-based skill checks, and Fortitude saves.
Seance Boon: You gain a +2 bonus on all non-spell damage rolls.
Influence Penalty: You take a penalty equal to your spirit bonus on Intelligence checks, Intelligence-based skill checks, spell DCs, spell attack rolls, and spell damage rolls.
Champion's Prowess (Lesser, Su): You gain proficiency in all martial and exotic weapons.
Sudden Attack (Intermediate, Su): Whenever you take a full-attack action, you gain one additional attack at your highest base attack bonus. This ability stacks with the extra attack from haste, but it doesn't stack with special actions that grant extra attacks, such as flurry of blows or spell combat. Sudden attack works as normal with full-attack options such as twoweapon fighting.
Fleet Charge (Greater, Su): Spend a swift action and a standard action to make a full attack against one enemy within your weapon's range. This ability works with Sudden Attack, haste, and two-weapon fighting. It does not grant movement; you can use your normal move action before or after the attack.
Legendary Champion (Supreme, Su): You gain Armor and Weapon Training as per the fighter.
In this mod, Legendary Champion grants two ranks in every fighter weapon-training group available in the game.
zhCN:
勇士英灵是武艺的典范。
英灵同调：降灵勇士时，你的英灵同调适用于攻击检定、战技检定（CMB）、非法术伤害掷骰、力量检定、基于力量的技能检定，以及强韧豁免。
降灵奖励：你的所有非法术伤害掷骰获得+2加值。
共鸣惩罚：你的智力检定、基于智力的技能检定，以及法术难度等级（DC）、法术攻击检定和法术伤害掷骰，承受等同于英灵同调的减值。
斗士之威（次级，超自然）：你擅长所有军用武器和异种武器。
瞬袭（中等，超自然）：每当你进行整轮攻击时，你都能以最高基本攻击加值额外攻击一次。此能力可与加速术提供的额外攻击叠加，但不能与疾风连击、法术战斗等提供额外攻击的特殊动作叠加。瞬袭可以正常配合双武器战斗等整轮攻击选项使用。
狂飙猛进（高等，超自然）：先以迅捷动作准备，1轮内以标准动作对武器范围内的敌人进行一次完整整轮攻击（可配合瞬袭、加速术、双武器战斗，不占用正常移动动作）。
传奇勇士（至高，超自然）：你获得战士职业的防具训练（2级）和游戏现有全部战士武器训练组各2级（+2攻击和伤害加值）。

enGB: First use Prepare Fleet Charge as a swift action. Within 1 round, use Fleet Charge as a standard action to make one full attack against an enemy within your weapon's range, consuming the preparation. It works with Sudden Attack, haste, and two-weapon fighting. It grants no movement; your normal move action remains available. Ending the channeled power removes the preparation.

enGB: The champion spirit gives you some of his strength, granting you armor and weapon training feats. You gain two ranks in every fighter weapon-training group available in the game, giving a +2 weapon-training bonus to attacks and damage with those weapons.
zhCN: 勇士英灵将部分力量借给你，赋予你防具训练与武器训练专长。你获得游戏现有的全部战士武器训练组，每组两级，对相应武器的攻击和伤害提供+2武器训练加值。
